newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: City Developments sees block deal.
newsitem.headline: City Developments sees block deal.

text.p: Property heavyweight City Developments Ltd (CityDev) saw a block deal of three million shares at Singapore $13 each in mid afternoon trade on Tuesday, said dealers.
At 0726 GMT, the stock was trading at S$12.90. Total volume was 3.49 million shares including the block trade.
Most dealers were in the dark as to who the buyer or seller of the block was.
"Property and bank stocks have been firming up. But the price is not cheap," said a dealer with a local brokerage.
CityDev officials were not available for comment.
